origin.details: Names are the column names and the values are widths.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
spec <- fwf_cols(name = 20, state = 10)
paste(paste(spec$begin, collapse = ","), paste(spec$end, collapse = ","), paste(spec$col_names, collapse = ","), sep = ";")
